decision: Correct atom-overlap retrieval that starved primitive search, then measure certified checked-lemma reuse and retained neural selection without reusing the inspected full-composition families.
source: Freeze Git source, binary, protocol, all native question identities and structural-family assignments before final inference. All seeds finish all learning and selection before first confirmation inference. Pilot may use development only; never import its weights or proofs. Earlier inspected composition families and every possible sibling in their original generator are retired before building the new bank. The corrective run uses only new full structural families; no prior weights or proofs are imported.
common: Fresh random native policy and actual zero-update Adam snapshot. Seven question-only helper selections from original learning logical families, ID ordered with distinct conservative shape and bounded formula size; 64 balanced additional own searches. Only actual checker-admitted helper discoveries populate the fixed knowledge/definition dictionary shared by B/C. All unsuccessful or unavailable helper cases remain in the denominator. The later ID-shuffled bootstrap/learning schedule excludes those seven already-queried helper IDs before any outcome, so they are not scheduled twice. Repeated exact native derivations, if found for another eligible orientation, reuse this run's already checked Graph root and are explicitly not counted as new mathematical admission.
learning: Two rounds of 80 new composition learning questions plus 48 original/frontier learning questions, own search at 128 expansions with existing 20 percent exploration. Each admitted source/closure passes ordinary native Graph admission before replay. At most 32 retained proofs and 32768 serialized state bytes; exact larger traces are bounded references to the canonical owned source record. No teacher proof or previous checkpoint import.
optimization: Existing 250 Adam updates per ready candidate, batch 16, LR .001, CPU Flex float32, 1004001 parameters. Same original work, IO and artifact limits; 10-update durable quanta remain. Save all candidate and retained model/Adam pairs, own traces, costs and rejections.
selection: Preserve the original 64 selection questions and four earlier anchors; append 32 new composition-development questions in 16 full structural groups. Incumbent and candidate see the identical immutable checked knowledge/definition snapshot. Strict total success gain, no lost original sentinel success and no earlier-anchor regression. Rejection restores weights and Adam together; 126 work units.
confirmation: 64 prospectively sealed new full-composition cases in 32 conservative structural families, generated with tails 3..7 and cyclic dead ends 4..7; every possible family from the previous 1..4/1..4 generator is retired first. 64 new full-composition cases in 32 conservative structural families; names/atomic arguments do not separate siblings. Known intermediate statements and repeated logical recipes are deliberately shared, while whole target native identities are never anywhere in the dictionary dependency closure. This is known-subproblem/new-composition evidence, not unseen mathematics or production prevalence.

arms.A_primitive: Actual common fresh checkpoint with empty theorem and definition dictionary.
arms.B_frozen_with_knowledge: Exactly A weights and Adam, plus common checked dictionaries.
arms.C_retained_with_knowledge: Production-gate retained checkpoint with exactly B dictionaries.
arms.C_missing: C with every dictionary entry whose checked closure contains the source helper corresponding to that case removed. This prevents a dependent entry from retaining the removed answer. Report removed-entry counts and cases where it was already absent.
arms.D_last_unselected_candidate: Last training candidate before production selection, shown only as diagnosis; never substitute it for C or claim it is retained. It may equal the selected candidate.

budgets: Primary 32 shared high-level expansions, no exploration. Secondary A/B/C 128 shared expansions with identical existing 20 percent exploration seed. Original 32 facts, 16 candidate actions, 32 depth, 256 graph nodes, 48 context roots, 2500 ms per orientation including retrieval. No caps or checker rules relaxed.
cost: Report total wall, search and model-load wall, actual retrieval and dependency work, all submitted native checker calls/steps including repeated checks, native root and closure proof steps, concrete citations/definition dependencies, model/Adam serialized bytes and native runtime IO separately. A macro action is not one primitive checker operation; equal bounds do not imply equal actual compute. Engineering planning/curation and training cost are additional lifetime work.
success: For B-A and C-B separately: mean certified-success gain at least 5 percentage points, paired 20000-draw structural-group bootstrap 95 percent lower bound above zero, and no negative seed. A knowledge-reuse claim additionally requires at least 10 successful confirmation cases with concrete citations to the preexisting dictionary. Also report a source-helper-family bootstrap as a dependence sensitivity, conditional on these seven known source problems. Otherwise state the measured effect and uncertainty without forcing a positive result.
stopping: Fixed two rounds per seed, no confirmation-driven tuning or successor loop. Preserve negative results, invalid attempts and exact source/input/checkpoint hashes. Local only except the already authorized update of the same Draft MR332; no merge or publication.
